title: Narra 4.1.1
message: This release fixes guest access, account confirmation, Premium device warnings and privacy controls.
changelog: Guests now enter Narra normally without being forced to create or sign in to an account.
Fixed signed-account confirmation and Premium activation while keeping free access separate from donations.
New accounts send an email confirmation, and password recovery now clearly covers inbox and spam folders.
Added a clear Premium three-device warning with actual connected-device counts.
Added editable contextual or personalized ad privacy controls in Profile.
Redesigned the update and first-run privacy dialogs with clearer download progress and choices.
